topics.title: Isaias moves across Gulf Coast
topics.summary: Hurricane Isaias made landfall in Florida as a Category 2 storm, with Gulf Coast states watching for surge, flooding and power disruptions.
topics.discussionPrompt: When a storm arrives after days of forecast watching, who trusts the official checklist and who starts improvising with pantry snacks?

topics.title: Panama shaken by powerful quakes
topics.summary: Two strong earthquakes and aftershocks rattled Panama, prompting evacuations and reminders that the region sits along the Pacific Ring of Fire.
topics.discussionPrompt: If the ground suddenly reminds everyone it has plans, who grabs the emergency bag and who checks whether the pictures stayed level?

topics.title: US-Russia diesel deal stirs debate
topics.summary: A White House deal to buy Russian diesel drew criticism from Ukraine supporters while officials argued it could ease high fuel prices.
topics.discussionPrompt: When a fuel-price fix comes with a diplomatic headache, who talks strategy and who just wants the gas receipt to stop hurting?

topics.title: Ukraine talks face fresh strain
topics.summary: Ukraine criticized new US-Russia fuel diplomacy as talks continued, while reports of strikes and energy security concerns kept pressure on negotiations.
topics.discussionPrompt: When peace talks and side deals happen at the same time, who thinks it is clever chess and who calls it a mixed signal?

topics.title: AI safety returns to spotlight
topics.summary: At San Francisco Tech Week, AI founders welcomed a lighter federal approach while critics questioned whether voluntary safeguards are enough.
topics.discussionPrompt: If companies are asked to police their own super-smart tools, who trusts the honor system and who wants a bigger rulebook?

topics.title: France wrestles with budget pressure
topics.summary: Protests over public spending are colliding with market worries about debt, leaving France's government searching for a workable budget path.
topics.discussionPrompt: When everyone wants a budget to do opposite things, who brings a spreadsheet and who brings a dramatic sigh?

topics.title: India tightens protest security
topics.summary: Indian authorities detained protesters and expanded security in New Delhi as youth-led anger grew over a disputed voter list revision.
topics.discussionPrompt: When young people turn a technical election issue into a street movement, who studies the rules and who watches the mood shift?

topics.title: TSA chair rule draws union anger
topics.summary: A union criticized a move removing chairs from TSA checkpoints, saying morale and basic working conditions matter for airport staff.
topics.discussionPrompt: If a workplace rule is supposed to look professional but makes people miserable, who enforces it and who quietly drags the chair back?

topics.title: Surf breaks face climate risk
topics.summary: A new climate study warns many famous surf breaks could be reshaped by rising seas and changing coastal conditions.
topics.discussionPrompt: If a favorite beach slowly changes shape, who sees science in motion and who just mourns the perfect wave?

topics.title: Panama cleanup checks begin
topics.summary: Officials assessed damaged buildings and transport disruptions after Panama's quakes while residents waited for clearer safety updates.
topics.discussionPrompt: When a city has to pause and inspect everything, who gets patient and who starts ranking the most inconvenient delays?
